- OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is acquiring ADT in a $15.3 billion deal to integrate AI into home security. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/29/openai-backed-thrive-holdings-acquires-adt/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-backed-thrive-holdings-to-acquire-adt-in-15-3b-all-cash-deal/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/thrive-holdings-buy-adt-security-15-3-billion-cash))
- Reddit is shifting to a logged-in experience to protect its business as AI transforms search traffic. ### Google Announces Gemini 4 Carbon With Focus on Cybersecurity and Coding
Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28, describing it as its strongest artificial intelligence model, with improved cybersecurity capabilities and the ability to handle complex, long-running tasks. The model is designed to identify software vulnerabilities, assess security risks and develop… ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/google-announces-gemini-4-carbon-with-focus-on-cybersecurity-and-coding), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2300677/google-gemini-carbon-promises-significant-leap-in-ai-coding-and-cybersecurity/))

### OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/29/openai-backed-thrive-holdings-acquires-adt/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-backed-thrive-holdings-to-acquire-adt-in-15-3b-all-cash-deal/))

### As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/29/as-search-traffic-dries-up-reddit-announces-its-shifting-to-a-logged-in-experience/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/reddit-announces-shift-to-primarily-logged-in-experience/))

### How we detect frontier model misalignment
OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate. ### NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang may have been the target of a Chinese government spy
President Trump reportedly chose to do nothing in response. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2301447/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-may-have-been-the-target-of-a-chinese-government-spy/), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/29/us/politics/nvidia-china-jensen-huang-trump.html))
